intent: Technical Brief: MSI Vector GP68 HX 12V System State Baseline
detected_fault: Overheating issues with CPU (P cores) reaching temperatures up to 100°C before throttling, particularly when playing demanding games like Helldivers 2.
suggested_solution: Verify BIOS version and update if necessary
Inspect system for blockages or dust buildup that may be contributing to overheating issue
Consider installing a heat sink on suspected chip (between RAM and M.2 drives)
Adjust fan settings and ensure proper airflow through laptop's vents
